app_fee.value: International applicants pay a $70 non-refundable application fee for degree programs.

fee_waiver.value: Waivers cover narrow groups only: automatic for degrees from US land-grant or Colorado HLC-accredited institutions, plus US military, Peace Corps, AmeriCorps and Fulbright. No general international waiver is stated.
fee_waiver.quote: CSU supports fee waivers for Graduate School applicants who can demonstrate participation in or affiliation with the following organizations:

also.quote: Application fees are automatically waived if you earned a bachelor’s degree or higher from a regionally (HLC) accredited Colorado Institution or a U.S. Land-Grant Institution

gre_general.value: Each department decides whether the GRE is required; see the program records.
gre_general.quote: Contact the academic department to verify whether the GRE/GMAT is required.

toefl_min.value: From January 2026 the unconditional TOEFL iBT minimum is 4.5 on the new 1-6 scale.

ielts_min.value: IELTS minimum of 6.5 for unconditional admission, including the OneSkills Retake.
ielts_min.quote: IELTS: (including the IELTS OneSkills Retake) Minimum ... score of 6.5

english_waiver.value: The exemptions cover only solely-English countries, recent US degrees and countries on the exempt list. India is not on that list, so an English-medium Indian degree does not waive the English test.
english_waiver.quote: Students are exempted from the TOEFL, IELTS, Duolingo, or PTE Academic requirement if the official language of their country is solely English, or if they have recently earned a degree at a university in the United States, or if they have recently earned a degree from a university in a country on the English Language Proficiency Exempt List maintained by the Graduate School as published below.

also.quote: English language proficiency testing is not required for applicants who are citizens of the following countries:

notes: Checked 2026-10-26. The English page's minimum-score figures sit in a table, so they are not quoted; the 2026 bulletin states the same TOEFL 4.5 and IELTS 6.5. Conditional-admission minimums in the bulletin (TOEFL 3.5, IELTS 5.5) are for provisional admission only and are not used. Free application days in 2024-2025 are past. No blocked URLs.
